description:
A music player that respects what's yours.

Noctis is a desktop music player for your local library — fast browsing,
synced lyrics, metadata editing, EQ, and more.
Discord
Download
Pick your platform from the Assets below:
──────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Platform          │Files
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Windows           │Noctis-v1.5.1-Setup.exe (installer) · Noctis-windows-x64.zip (portable)
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
macOS             │Noctis-osx-arm64.dmg (Apple Silicon) · Noctis-osx-x64.dmg (Intel)
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Linux             │Noctis-x86_64.AppImage · Noctis-linux-x64.tar.gz · Noctis-linux-arm64.tar.gz
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Self-hosted server│noctis-server-linux-x64.tar.gz · noctis-server-linux-arm64.tar.gz (see docs/SELF-HOSTING.md)
──────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> Running on macOS — the app isn't code-signed, so Gatekeeper quarantines it on first launch. After dragging Noctis into your Applications folder, clear the flag once in Terminal:
>
> xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Noctis.app
>
> Then open Noctis normally.
What's Changed
Fixed
- Fixed "&" splitting duo artist names
- Fixed audio visualizer invisible under Kawarp
- Fixed music video shown cropped to a square
- Fixed lyrics header artist line acting as one button
- Fixed lyrics header track count showing wrong disc total
- Fixed language reverting to system default after restart
- Fixed gray window background on Dark/Midnight themes
- Fixed Lyrics Studio missing embedded LRC lyrics
- Fixed drag and drop not working from Folders page
- Fixed removing library folder stopping playback
- Fixed partially downloaded albums showing under Singles & EPs
- Fixed Kawarp showing still image for some albums
- Fixed island shuffle glyph staying white while active
- Fixed Music Video menu item showing for songs with no clip
- Fixed Previous button falling through to global history
- Fixed visualizer showing static dots on Linux/macOS
Added
- Added Turkish language support
- Added Playback time option in player island
- Added Drift (no beat) flowing lyrics background
- Added Import dropped files toggle in Settings
- Added drag rows onto queue popup to append
- Added Fade on play and pause setting
- Added Playlist page toggles (album headers, NEW badge, columns)
- Added Custom track badges with color pills and sort mode
- Added visualizer support for Linux/macOS (side-decode audio feed)
Improved
- Improved Type filter icon distinction from Songs filter
- Improved multi-selection drag to preserve order
Full Changelog: v1.5.0...v1.5.1
